documents.title: Quarterly Compliance Report on Corporate governance - within 21 days from the end of the quarter
Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Connplex Cinemas Limited reported strong financial and operational performance for H2FY26 and FY26, driven by accelerated screen additions and a robust theatrical recovery in the Indian box office. Total revenue grew by 54% YoY to INR 14,752 lakhs for FY26, while EBITDA increased by 33% YoY to INR 3,493 lakhs, although EBITDA margins experienced some contraction due to higher employee and administrative expenses. The company expanded its operational footprint to 41 cinemas with 113 screens across 9 states and highlighted a strong pipeline of 230+ upcoming screens across FY27 and FY28. Connplex Cinemas reported financial results for the half year and full year ended March 31, 2026, highlighting strong growth in revenue, EBITDA, and profit after tax. Management noted an expansion in operational footprints, reaching 41 cinemas and 113 screens across 9 states, driven by an asset-light franchise model.

guidance.claim: The company expects strong double-digit volume growth supported by screen additions and rising footfall trends for FY27 and beyond.
guidance.quote: Looking ahead to FY27 and beyond, we expect strong double-digit volume growth, supported by screen additions and rising footfall trends, we foresee continued revenue growth momentum driven by both ticket and non-ticket streams.

guidance.claim: Management expects margin stability supported by operating leverage and cost optimization.
guidance.quote: We expect margin stability, supported by operating leverage and cost optimization.

guidance.claim: The company anticipates an EBITDA margin in the range of 26% to 27%.
guidance.quote: This we are talking about PAT margin, and we expect an EBITDA margin in the range of 26% to 27%.

guidance.claim: The company targets to add around 50 to 60 screens by the end of the current financial year.
guidance.quote: We'll be introducing around 50 to 60 screens by this financial year end, and we'll be adding another 60 to 75 screens by next financial year end, which is FY27.

guidance.claim: Management stated a long-term ambitious goal to operate around 1,000 screens by 2030.
guidance.quote: Looking further ahead, by 2030, we aim to operate around 1,000 screens—our ambitious, long- term goal for the company.

guidance.claim: The company has projected 60 screens to be added during the full year 2025-26.
guidance.quote: As of March 31, 2025, we had a total of 66 screens. We plan to add 60 more screens during the full year 2025–26.

guidance.claim: The company targets adding around 41 screens in the second half of the year.
guidance.quote: So, for H2, our target is around 41 screens.

demand_outlook.claim: The Indian box office witnessed a sharp revival with overall collections growing between 15% to 20% on a YoY basis.
demand_outlook.quote: The Indian box office witnessed a sharp revival, with overall collections growing between 15% to 20% on a YoY basis.

demand_outlook.claim: Hindi cinema witnessed a strong recovery growing over 50% YoY.
demand_outlook.quote: Hindi cinema, in particular, witnessed a strong recovery, growing over 50% YoY, while regional cinema — especially Telugu and Tamil — continued to deliver consistent performance.

demand_outlook.claim: Smaller cities continued to emerge as key growth drivers for the sector due to rising discretionary income and limited alternative entertainment options.
demand_outlook.quote: Smaller cities continued to emerge as key growth drivers for the sector. Rising discretionary income, limited alternative entertainment options, and growing acceptance of organized multiplex formats led to structurally higher footfalls and better screen productivity in these markets.

demand_outlook.claim: Management highlighted strong demand for premium cinema experiences in underpenetrated markets, allowing the company to establish a dominant presence in high-growth regions.
demand_outlook.quote: By offering customized seating configurations and maintaining lean operating structures, the company capturesstrong demand for premium cinema experiences in underpenetrated markets.

demand_outlook.claim: Viewer footfall grew by 69% year-on-year to reach 12.16 lakh viewers in H1 FY26.
demand_outlook.quote: During H1FY26, we welcomed 12.16 lakh viewers, representing a growth of 69% YoY.

demand_outlook.claim: Occupancy levels improved to 32% from 30% in the previous year.
demand_outlook.quote: Occupancy levels improved to 32% from 30% last year, reflecting both robust content performance and our focused footfall-enhancing initiatives.

demand_outlook.claim: Average ticket price grew by 6% year-on-year to Rs. 243 from Rs. 229.
demand_outlook.quote: Our Average Ticket Price grew 6% YoY to ₹243 from ₹229, while Food & Beverage Spend Per Head stood at ₹94.

demand_outlook.claim: Advertising revenue increased by 107% year-on-year to Rs. 112.38 lakhs.
demand_outlook.quote: Advertising revenue also maintained strong traction, up 107% YoY to ₹112.38 lakhs.

demand_outlook.claim: The Indian box office witnessed overall collections rising by 15% year-on-year with over 20 films crossing the Rs. 100 crore mark.
demand_outlook.quote: The Indian box office witnessed a strong revival during the first half year, with 20+ films crossing the ₹100 crore mark and overall collections rising 15% YoY.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the fastest growth is coming from Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities.
demand_outlook.quote: The fastest growth is definitely coming from Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities.

capex_expansion.claim: FY26 saw the company expand its operational footprint to 41 cinemas with 113 screens across 9 states.
capex_expansion.quote: FY26 saw a step-up in our operational footprint as we expanded to 41 cinemas with 113 screens across 9 states.

capex_expansion.claim: The company added 30 screens in H2FY26 alone.
capex_expansion.quote: We added 30 screens in H2FY26 itself, demonstrating accelerated execution.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has 230+ upcoming screens planned across the FY27 and FY28 pipeline.
capex_expansion.quote: Looking ahead we have 230+ upcoming screens planned across FY27 and FY28 pipeline.

capex_expansion.claim: The company added 30 new screens during the second half of fiscal year 2026.
The company plans over 230 new upcoming screens across fiscal years 2027 and 2028.
capex_expansion.quote: 230+ New Upcoming Screens in FY27 & FY28

capex_expansion.claim: During H1 FY26, the company added 17 new screens, bringing the total portfolio to 31 cinemas, 83 screens, and 6,831 seats across 9 states.
capex_expansion.quote: Connplex delivered strong momentum in H1FY26, adding 17 new screens, 2 CAGR growth of 66% with several more in advanced stages and expected to open in the second half of the financial year once unit occupancy certificates are received. With this, as on date our total portfolio stands at 31 cinemas, comprising 83 screens and 6,831 seats across 9 states — further strengthening our pan-India presence.

capex_expansion.claim: In H1 FY26, the company added 8 screens in the Express Model, 3 screens in the Signature Model, and 6 screens in the Luxuriance Model.
capex_expansion.quote: In H1FY26, the company added 8 Screens in Express Model, 3 Screens in Signature Model and 6 Screens in Luxuriance Model.

capex_expansion.claim: The cost of one projector averages around Rs. 27 lakhs to Rs. 28 lakhs.
capex_expansion.quote: The cost of one projector is around INR 27 lakhs to INR 28 lakhs on average.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA Margin for FY26 stood at 23.68%, representing a decline of 377 bps YoY due to higher operational and expansion-related costs.
margins_costs.quote: ► EBITDA Margin stood at 23.68%, a decline of 377 bps YoY, primarily due to higher operational and expansion-related costs.

margins_costs.claim: Employee headcount increased from 96 employees as of March 31, 2025 to 143.
margins_costs.quote: As of 31st March 2025, we had 96 employees, which has now increased to 143.

margins_costs.claim: Employee costs rose from INR 5.24 crore to INR 9.95 crore.
margins_costs.quote: Correspondingly, employee costs have risen from INR 5.24 crore to INR 9.95 crore.

margins_costs.claim: Advertising and marketing expenses increased from around INR 9.6 crore last year to INR 17.79 crore.
margins_costs.quote: Last year (FY25), these were around INR 9.6 crore, and this year they have increased to INR 17.79 crore.

margins_costs.claim: Revenue grew by 57% year-on-year to Rs. 6,406 lakhs in H1 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: ► Revenue grew by 57% YoY to ₹6,406 lakhs, driven by strong growth in ticket sales, food & beverage revenues, space rentals/private events, and advertising income.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA increased by 39% year-on-year to Rs. 1,786 lakhs during H1 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: ► EBITDA increased by 39% YoY to ₹1,786 lakhs during the period.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin stood at 27.87%, registering a decline of 366 bps year-on-year due to higher operational and expansion-related costs.
margins_costs.quote: ► EBITDA Margin stood at 27.87%, a decline of 366 bps YoY, primarily due to higher operational and expansion-related costs.

margins_costs.claim: PAT grew by 36% year-on-year to Rs. 1,305 lakhs, with the PAT margin at 20.4%.
margins_costs.quote: ► PAT grew by 36% YoY to ₹1,305 lakhs, with PAT Margin at 20.4%, compared to 23.6% in the same period last year.

margins_costs.claim: The margin for the EPC/cinema construction business is approximately 30%.

orders_capacity.claim: Total footfalls increased to 27.63 lakh admits, up approximately 63% YoY.
orders_capacity.quote: We delivered strong operating metrics during the year with total footfalls increased to 27.63 lakh admits, up ~63% YoY.

orders_capacity.claim: Average Ticket Price increased to INR 264, up approximately 6% YoY.
orders_capacity.quote: Average Ticket Price increased to ₹264, up ~6% YoY.

orders_capacity.claim: Spend per head improved to INR 95 reflecting stronger F&B contribution.
orders_capacity.quote: Spend per head improved to ₹95, reflecting stronger F&B contribution.

orders_capacity.claim: As on date, total operational screens stand at 88.
orders_capacity.quote: Right now, we are at 88 operational.

capital_allocation.claim: Total debt as on FY26 is almost nil.
capital_allocation.quote: ► The total debt as on FY26 is almost Nil providing adequate room to raise debt in future.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has a comfortable net cash position at INR 7,615 lakhs as of March 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: ► The company has comfortable net cash position at ₹ 7,615 Lakhs as of March’26.

capital_allocation.claim: The company follows an 80:20 revenue-sharing model where 80% goes to the franchisee and 20% is retained as royalty.
capital_allocation.quote: Sir, we follow an 80:20 revenue-sharing model, where 80% goes to the franchisee and 20% is retained by us as royalty from ticket sales, F&B sales, and advertising revenue.

capital_allocation.claim: Out of the total IPO funds of INR 24 crores, approximately INR 1.40 crores was utilized for purchasing technological assets within the first 30 days.
capital_allocation.quote: Within those 30 days, we utilized approximately INR 1.40 crores for purchasing our technological assets — specifically LEDs and projectors.

management_commitments.claim: The company has 230+ upcoming screens planned across the FY27 and FY28 pipeline.
management_commitments.quote: Looking ahead we have 230+ upcoming screens planned across FY27 and FY28 pipeline.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to add around 80–85 more screens in FY26–27.
management_commitments.quote: Based on our current plans and assumptions, we expect to add around 80–85 more screens in FY26–27, and potentially even exceed 100.

management_commitments.claim: For FY27–28, the company is targeting a growth of approximately 25% in terms of screens.
management_commitments.quote: Similarly, for FY27–28, we are targeting a growth of approximately 25% or there abouts.

management_commitments.claim: The company lined up over 230 new upcoming screens for fiscal years 2027 and 2028.
management_commitments.quote: 230+ New Upcoming Screens in FY27 & FY28

management_commitments.quote: We'll be introducing around 50 to 60 screens by this financial year end, and we'll be adding another 60 to 75 screens by next financial year end, which is FY27.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to operate around 1,000 screens by 2030.
management_commitments.quote: Looking further ahead, by 2030, we aim to operate around 1,000 screens—our ambitious, long- term goal for the company.

management_commitments.claim: The target for H2 is around 41 screens.
management_commitments.quote: So, for H2, our target is around 41 screens.
